description.p: Opens PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, TIFF, BMP, icon and SVG pictures from Files, zooms, pans, rotates and flips them, saves a photo’s rotation without re-encoding it, steps through a folder, moves pictures to the Trash, plays animations and slideshows, copies them and shows their size, dimensions and camera details.
PDF documents scroll continuously with page thumbnails and their table of contents and can be rotated; their text can be selected, copied and searched, and locked documents open with their password.
